english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an unwanted delay holding up a scheduled event, service, or activity.

exampleSentences.english: The flight had a delay because of heavy rain.
exampleSentences.jyutping: baan1 gei1 jan1 wai6 daai6 jyu5 jau5 jin4 ng6

english.note: Use this when the wait is a delay to a service, journey, event, or schedule rather than simply time spent waiting.

exampleSentences.english: The flight delay made us wait for an hour.
exampleSentences.traditional: 班機延誤，搞到我哋等咗一個鐘。
exampleSentences.jyutping: baan1 gei1 jin4 ng6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 jat1 go3 zung1
